rows: Question put, "That clause 2 stand part of the Bill."
The Committee divided: Ayes, 23; Noes, 23; Abstention, Nil; Absent, 3; Paired, 2.

The result of the voting is 23 Ayes, 23 Noes, 3 Absent, and 2 Paired. Under section 53 of the Constitution - and I will read that section - it says:

`Save as otherwise provided in this Order, all questions proposed for decision in the Assembly shall be determined by a majority of the votes of the Members present and voting; and if, upon any question before the Assembly, the votes of the Members are equally divided, the motion shall be lost.'
Therefore, the motion is lost. There is now no clause 2 and the Bill is meaningless. Anyway, the Bill will have to be reported.
